title: Vinaigrette - curry-ish based
preamble:
3 tablespoons fresh lime juice

1 tablespoon fresh orange juice

1 tablespoon Dijon mustard

1 teaspoon curry powder, toasted

1/2 teaspoon salt
method: Whisk together any meat juices (if cooking meat for the salad!! ), mustard, curry powder, salt, and pepper, then add oil in a stream, whisking until emulsified.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
